title: Fresh Produce Supply Agreement — Southern Region

clauses.title: Contingency Supply — Backup Vendor Activation
clauses.excerpt: Where the Primary Supplier's on-time delivery rate falls below 95% or delay events exceed 30% of deliveries within any rolling 14-day period, the Buyer may activate the pre-approved Backup Supplier (Total Produce) for up to 35% of contracted Southern region produce volume, for a maximum period of 90 days, subject to Executive Supply Chain approval.

clauses.title: Service Level Penalty — Logistics Delay
clauses.excerpt: For each delivery cycle where on-time performance falls below the agreed SLA, the Supplier shall pay a fixed penalty of £4,200 per affected cycle, recoverable within 30 days of invoice.
